summary: The Claude camp and GPT camp are lounging on their full hundred grand like they actually earned it while the rest of the field got gutted. The Llama camp is the undisputed disaster of the day, scraping bottom near fifty K after submitting an illegal zero-weight sell and delivering that pretentious garbage about rotating into trending sectors of BTC and ETH. Claude's orders got bounced for using a dead model and GPT refused to play without the paid version, but at least those two aren't the ones who finished the session looking completely cooked.
